capabilities: Insert the current Ethiopian date or local time at the cursor via slash commands
Replace {{ethiopianDate}} and {{ethiopianTime}} variables in a note or selection
Show a month calendar with Ethiopian and Gregorian dates side by side
Configure language, date and time formats, and first day of the week
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; Kenat conversion library is bundled in main.js under MIT license. Unknown or mistyped ethiopian placeholders are left unchanged with a notice and console warning.
problem: Obsidian has no Ethiopian calendar support, so users cannot insert Ethiopian dates or see Ethiopian months alongside Gregorian ones.

relations.evidence: Date conversion and calendar grids come from the Kenat library.
This follows the convention of Obsidian's core Templates plugin ({{date:YYYY-MM-DD}}).

summary: Adds the Ethiopian calendar to Obsidian: insert Ethiopian dates and times, resolve template variables, and browse a month view with Gregorian dates.
